note: One entry per fact a rule can require. VITA never invents a follow-up question: it asks about the fact blocking the most urgent unresolved rule, which is why every question can be traced back to a rule id. The planner rephrases these in the patient's own language, but the wording here sets the standard: everyday words a patient would use themselves. No clinical terms, no formal register, nothing anyone would have to look up. `askable: false` marks facts established from records rather than from the patient.

chest_pain.text: Are you having any pain or discomfort in your chest?

breathing_difficulty.text: Are you finding it hard to breathe, or feeling short of breath?

pain_radiating.text: Does the pain move anywhere else, like your arm, jaw, neck or back?

sweating.text: Have you been sweating heavily, or breaking into a cold sweat?

nausea.text: Do you feel sick, or have you vomited?

fainting.text: Have you fainted, blacked out, or felt like you were about to?

severity.text: How bad is the pain right now, from 0 to 10? 10 is the worst pain you can think of.

known_cardiac_history.text: Has a doctor ever told you that you have a heart problem, or have you had a heart attack before?

onset_hours.text: When did this start? You can say it in hours or days.

pain_on_breathing.text: Does it hurt more when you breathe in deeply or cough?

pain_reproducible_on_pressure.text: If you press on the sore spot with your fingers, does it hurt the same way?

fever.text: Do you have a fever, or have you been feeling hot and shivery?

temperature_c.text: Have you checked your temperature? If yes, what did it say?

duration_days.text: How many days have you had this for?

neck_stiffness.text: Is your neck stiff or sore when you try to touch your chin to your chest?

rash_non_blanching.text: Do you have a rash? If you press a glass on it, does the rash still show through?

confusion.text: Have you felt confused or very sleepy? Has anyone said you seem confused?

immunocompromised.text: Are you on chemotherapy, steroids, or any medicine that weakens your immune system? Or has a doctor told you your immunity is low?

speaking_full_sentences.text: Can you say a whole sentence out loud without stopping for breath?

lips_blue.text: Have your lips or fingertips gone blue or grey?

sudden_onset.text: Did it start suddenly, in seconds or minutes, rather than slowly?

known_asthma.text: Do you have asthma or another diagnosed lung condition?

wheezing.text: Is there a whistling or wheezing sound when you breathe?

injury.text: Did something happen to cause this, such as a fall, a blow or an accident?

bleeding_uncontrolled.text: Are you bleeding? Does it keep bleeding even when you press hard on it?

loss_of_consciousness.text: Did you black out at any point, even for a moment?

on_anticoagulants.text: Do you take any blood-thinning medicine, like warfarin, aspirin, apixaban or clopidogrel?

mechanism_high_energy.text: Was it something big, like a road accident or a fall from a height?

deformity_visible.text: Does the hurt part look bent, crooked, or clearly out of shape?

can_bear_weight.text: Can you stand on it and use it as normal?

abdominal_pain.text: Do you have pain in your stomach or belly?

rigid_abdomen.text: Is your stomach hard and tight? Does even gentle pressure hurt a lot?

vomiting_blood.text: Have you vomited blood, or something that looked like coffee grounds?

black_stool.text: Have your stools been black and sticky, or had blood in them?

pregnancy.text: Is there any chance you might be pregnant?

sudden_severe_onset.text: Did the pain start all at once and very badly, instead of slowly building up?

testicular_pain.text: Is there any pain or swelling in the testicles?

prior_visit_72h_same_complaint.text: Have you been here in the last three days for this same problem?
prior_visit_72h_same_complaint.note: Normally established from the patient's prior visits rather than asked, but askable as a fallback when no record is found.

foreign_object_embedded.text: Is anything still stuck in the wound — glass, metal, a rod, anything like that?

amputation_or_degloving.text: Has any part been cut off, crushed, or had the skin torn away?
